product_metadata.title: CHICHIC Popsicle Molds Ice Pop Makers Ice Pop Molds Ice Bar Maker Plastic Popsicle Mold, Kids Ice Cream Tray Holder Lolly Pops, Kitchen Supply(Mixed Large)
features: SIZE - Popsicle molds for kids: 6.7 x 4.7 x 4.3 inch. ►►► Popsicle molds for adults: 6.7 x 4.7 x 6.1 inch. ►►►Large mold can hold about 2.04oz water, small mold holds about 1.7oz. INSTRUCTION - Just lift individual molds from base by pulling pop stick. Unmold under warm water for a few seconds OR just wait for 1 to 2 minutes at normal temperature, and the ice pop will easily slide out of the mold !!!
CHICHIC Set of 6 ice pop molds are made of durable plastic. You could use them again and again in the freezer for years to come.
Special design keeps pops from tipping while freezing, after frozen individual pops fit neatly in freezer to save space. Enjoy a lifetime of tasty, ice pops straight from the freezer!

CHICHIC Set of 6 ice pop molds are made especially for freezing juices and other ingredients into perfect freezer pops. You can create your own unique frozen treats using juices, purees, yogurt, gelatin, fruit, ice cream, pudding, jams and jellies. It is an excellent gift as well!
